entities.summary: Adi Arieta Koila Josephine Mara Nailatikau is a member and daughter of one of Fiji’s Chiefly Families the Paramount Rulers of the Lauan Islands The Vuanirewa Clan and a Fijian lawyer, who has served as a diplomat and politician. She was also First Lady of Fiji from 2009 until 2015, as the wife of Ratu Epeli Nailatikau, the President of Fiji.
